headline: Quarterly growth was uneven, with a few firms posting strong revenue gains while others faced modest growth and profit pressure.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from sub‑2% at Infosys to over 50% at Coforge. AI‑led deals boosted top‑line performance for several companies, but profit margins were mixed. Guidance was trimmed at Infosys and introduced at HCLTech and Wipro. Overall sector momentum is positive but uneven.

themes.title: AI‑driven services
themes.detail: AI revenue and AI‑led deal wins were highlighted across multiple firms, driving higher growth rates.

themes.title: Margin and guidance pressure
themes.detail: Infosys cut its FY27 revenue guidance, while other firms introduced modest guidance ranges.

leaders.why: Revenue grew 53.6% YoY and EBIT margin guidance was raised to 16%.
Revenue up 17.4% YoY with strong AI‑led contract wins and raised guidance.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and FY27 guidance was cut.
Revenue grew 9.1% YoY but net profit fell 1.9% and guidance was only introduced.
